insert into user_account(role, scenic_id, status, login_type, nickname, avatar_url, oauth_provider, oauth_open_id) values(#{role}, #{scenicId}, #{status}, #{loginType}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{provider}, #{openId})
